I initially joined the CCWJ lab through the MITACS Research internship Scholarship in the summer of 2019. After my internship, I went back to India to complete my undergrad, then I returned to the CCWJ to pursue my Masters. Recently my favorite pastimes are Skiing and hockey. My poster based on the internship was accepted for presentation at Fabtech 2019. I have a publication based on the importance of additive manufacturing in the automotive industry.

##### Prior Degrees

BTech, Metallurgical and Materials Enginnering, 2021

##### Project

I am working on methods to reduce fume emission during welding by understanding the deposition rate and controlling the heat input to the ideal amount through mass and energy balance.
